'''Beylyssa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who occasionally worked with [[Boddu Bocck]], and tried to capture [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] and [[Darrik]] while they were on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. She was later present on the [[Vengeance (Golthan)|''Vengeance'']] when [[Dirk Harkness]] and [[Jai Raventhorn]] destroyed the ship. She also worked with the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] bounty hunter [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] for a time; the two both had a love of all things explosive, though their partnership ended on less-than-amiable terms. She wore a suit of modified [[Arelik Armor]].
